status: Local prespecification before data generation; not an externally registered study
data_status: Entirely synthetic; no human, animal, neural or physical-field observations
question: Does intervention on an explicitly implemented previous-state memory change held-out prediction of a temporally dependent binary source?
scope: Operational causal access to predictive memory only; no consciousness, phenomenology, autonomous agency or scalar-field inference

source.transition: X[t]=X[t-1] with probability stay; otherwise flip
source.population_marginal: Stationary balanced Bernoulli(0.5); finite empirical balance is not forced

sample.training_test_split: Independent RNG seeds and disjoint trial identifiers; complete trials assigned before fitting

predictor.state: Previous source bit; no access to contemporaneous target or future bits
predictor.fit: Train-only 2x2 transition counts with symmetric Laplace pseudocount 1
predictor.reset_prediction: Train-only marginal P(next=1), with Laplace pseudocount 1
predictor.freeze: No refitting or tuning using held-out outcomes or interventions

interventions: intact: decoder uses the trial's own previous bit
reset: replace memory by null state; frozen decoder returns training marginal
cross_trial_swap: random pairing of held-out trials, reciprocal donor swap of previous-state sequences, no fixed points; exact marginal preservation at each prediction time
state_relabel: internal state becomes 1-previous_bit and decoder is conjugated accordingly; predictions must be bitwise identical to intact

scores.primary: Brier loss mean((p-y)^2), lower is better
scores.secondary: Natural-log loss mean(-y*log(p)-(1-y)*log(1-p)), lower is better
scores.effect: Paired intervention loss minus intact loss; positive means intervention worsens prediction

uncertainty.method: Percentile bootstrap of paired loss differences
uncertainty.cluster: Reciprocal-swap pair of two complete trials; resample all 64 transitions and both donor-linked trials together
uncertainty.reason: Serial dependence is retained within each trial, and reciprocal donor dependence is retained within each two-trial block
uncertainty.scope: Held-out sampling uncertainty conditional on the fitted predictor, fixed source parameters and prespecified pairing mechanism; does not include training-fit or real-world model uncertainty

prespecified_checks.positive_control: For Markov source, reset and swap paired Brier-loss 95% intervals are strictly above zero; log loss is corroborating secondary evidence
prespecified_checks.negative_control: For IID source, each reset and swap Brier-loss interval lies within [-0.01,0.01]; each log-loss interval within [-0.02,0.02]
prespecified_checks.equivalence_control: Relabeling gives exactly identical predictions and losses
prespecified_checks.leakage: Fitting accepts training partition only; training and test seed/IDs disjoint; decoder frozen; every prediction input is an own- or donor-trial bit at t-1
prespecified_checks.marginal_control: Swap has no fixed points and preserves previous-bit counts at every time

analysis_policy.interpretation: A successful run validates this synthetic operational memory mechanism and analysis pipeline, not the existence of conscious experience or a new physical field
